race.description: Moree And District Services Club Hcp (Bm58)
race.comment: MOON ZONE (8) wound up strongly last time out to finish a long neck adrift in third over this trip at Narromine. Should be winding up late again. MY NAME IS (1) opened the campaign in good order but has gone amiss in his last two. Has been freshened with a month between runs and gets the blinkers applied first time. Wary of sharp improvement. WINGED (7) has been freshened with 51 days after some moderate performances. Rates highly on his best form, so is worth keeping safe. TYSON'S DREAM (5) returns and did finish in the money first-up last prep at Tamworth over 1400m. Strips fitter for two lead-up trials. Looks next best.
